name: telegram
description: Telegram Bot channel. Receives webhook updates from Telegram, forwards to agent loop, sends replies via sendMessage API. Token injected by host — never visible to WASM.

bot_token_secret.description: Kernel keyring name for bot token

allowed_user_ids.description: Telegram user ID allowlist. Empty = allow all.

security.token_injection: Host injects token via clawos_secrets_get() — never passed as string to WASM
security.allowlist: allowed_user_ids checked before processing any message
